names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Συνέσιος του Ιρκούτσκ», with the rank word left off. No Russian form is recorded: saint.gr prints none.

death.note: The year stands only in the head line over his name on saint.gr's page, «Αγιος Συνεσιος Του Ιρκουτσκ (; - 1787)». The body of the page gives no year at all: its whole text is «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Αγίου.»

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). He is a Russian saint and that calendar is the one that would settle his day, his rank and his life; it was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Συνέσιος του Ιρκούτσκ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The page carries no asterisk and no sentence of self-doubt** — it is not one of the refusals of BRIEF-GREEK §10 — it simply says it has no details: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Αγίου.» **`types` is empty on purpose.** The only rank word the page gives him is Ἅγιος, which the corpus composes itself, and nothing on the page says whether he was a bishop, a monk or a layman; a type would be a guess, so none is used. It is named in the report. **He is not `theonas-called-synesius`**, the corpus's only other Synesius, who is an Egyptian of another day. **`locations` are left out**: Irkutsk is in the epithet and the page places him nowhere. No relics, no hymn, no century in the body.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
